methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches AI training program for workplace professionals - WDBJ7
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's workplace AI training program signals potential distributed depth-building outside metro corridors, though success depends on whether it creates sustained peer learning networks or remains institutionally contained.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's partnership with AI Ready RVA explicitly targets community-wide AI education and innovation, creating infrastructure for distributed capability-building beyond traditional tech sector boundaries in Virginia's second-tier metro.

signals.title: AI helped a Virginia mom launch Here Now Health and expand Medicaid mental health services - Межа. Новини України.
signals.signal_reading: A mom using AI to launch Medicaid mental health services demonstrates platform-enabled entrepreneurship—shallow but accessible adoption that distributes opportunity without requiring deep technical fluency.

signals.title: Digital Realty Acquires $7.8 bn Northern Virginia Data Center Portfolio from Blackstone to Expand AI Infrastructure - InfotechLead
signals.signal_reading: A $7.8B data center acquisition concentrates AI infrastructure capital in NoVA's existing dominance zone, reinforcing the metro hub's structural advantage while other regions compete for spillover effects.

signals.title: Virginia county asks all employees, including schools, to conserve power due to AI-driven electricity price hikes — state's 400-plus data centers steadily increasing demand, grid expansion, and pricing - Tom's Hardware
signals.signal_reading: AI-driven electricity demand forcing county-wide power conservation reveals how concentrated data center buildout creates negative externalities that strain public infrastructure without distributing economic or capability benefits to affected communities.
